name: Garin Heslop
headline: Co-founder & CEO of GYNERGY. Three-time founder and keynote speaker on rebuilding the operator.
formats: Keynotes, workshops and multi-day corporate programs
summary: Garin Heslop is the co-founder and CEO of GYNERGY, a San Diego company and AI operating system for human, leadership and business performance. A three-time founder, he became a self-made millionaire in real estate by 23, then built Medcare Farms into a $14M-a-year operation with more than 100 employees. After losing everything twice, he rebuilt from the inside out and now coaches CEOs, founders and athletes on integrating health, relationships, mindset, wealth and legacy. On stage he speaks on purpose-driven leadership, elite performance and using AI to amplify how people live and work.
